title: TDD is dead. Long live testing. (DHH)
summary: DHH declares test-first dead: it damaged his designs, mock-heavy unit tests are a jungle, and Rails will shift toward slower, real system tests.

assertions.quote: Test-first units leads to an overly complex web of intermediary objects and indirection in order to avoid doing anything that's “slow”.
The test-first part was a wonderful set of training wheels
Which btw do not need to be so slow any more, thanks to advances in parallelization and cloud runner infrastructure
I test active record models directly, letting them hit the database
Used as a hammer to beat down the nonbelievers, declare them unprofessional and unfit for writing software.
The worst thing we can do is just rush into another testing religion.
